list_papers: list daily papers on the Hub filtered by date, week, month, submitter, or sort order
search_papers: search papers on the Hub by query string and return matching results
get_paper_info: get detailed info about a paper on the Hub given its arXiv ID
read_paper: read a paper as markdown given its arXiv ID
run_papers_cli: run the papers CLI to interact with papers on the Hugging Face Hub
